scope: Every top-level named Rust type declared in src, including macro-generated IDs and spans. Standard/library forms are explained separately; dependency internals are not invented as application types.

groups.creator: Investigation builders and checked record import
groups.states: Validated as part of an Investigation; a valid record does not establish semantic truth
groups.ui: Graph and Harness Insight
groups.prevents: Mixing evidence, interpretation and unknowns

types.RecordId: Stable nonzero identity within one investigation; independent of graph position
types.FileOffset: u64 coordinate in an original file; range checked when used
types.MappedAddress: u64 declared CPU address; does not imply observed runtime memory
types.Observation: Owned bytes, a file offset and source description
types.Basis: Observed, Derived or Inferred provenance for an explanation
types.RecordData: Question, Probe, Observation, Firmware, Disassembly, Rea, Explanation, TypeHypothesis, Review or Unknown
types.HarnessInsight: Question, purpose, action, observation, explanation, uncertainty and next step
types.QuestionPlan: Why, steps, enables, answered_when and if_not fields for a question
types.Record: Stable identity, kind, concise summary, insight, note and explicit question ownership
types.Relation: Investigates, Produces, Supports, LeavesOpen, Suggests, Contradicts, Revises, Resolves, Steers or Reuses
types.Edge: Directed typed relationship between existing record IDs
types.Origin: WorkshopFixture or LocalArtifact; keeps synthetic material distinct
types.Artifact: Recorded name, byte length, hash, preview and optional parsed firmware report
types.Investigation: Canonical record store with edges and retained disassembly/model/REA receipts
types.Attention: Window reading cursor, available frontier, follow/hold state and reviewed arrivals; not serialized evidence

groups.creator: Checked ID constructors, scalar-view projection or analyst review
groups.states: ID role resolved against the owning case; interpretations remain interpretations
groups.ui: Evidence links, endian views and type-hypothesis form
groups.prevents: Treating a representation or citation as proof

types.QuestionId: Nonzero reference that resolves to a record with a question plan
types.ObservationId: Nonzero reference that resolves to completed evidence
types.InsightId: Nonzero reference to a record's human-facing insight
types.ByteOrder: Little or Big: the selected interpretation of observed bytes
types.F32Bits: u32 bits preserving NaN payloads and negative zero through JSON
types.ScalarViews: Optional u8, u16, u32 and f32 views; unavailable widths are None
types.TypeHypothesis: Proposed type, rationale, supporting/counter-evidence IDs and limitations

groups.creator: Identity constructors and checked ImageMap methods
groups.states: Digest syntax, owner identity, arithmetic and range checks; loaded DTOs are not fresh-byte capabilities
groups.ui: Declared address, image offset and original source fragments
groups.prevents: Cross-image references and accidental coordinate conversion

types.ImageOffset: u64 offset within a decoded image
types.ArtifactId: Validated lowercase SHA-256 identity of original carrier bytes
types.ImageId: Validated lowercase SHA-256 identity of a complete decoded image
types.ImageSpan: Nonempty half-open range tied to one ImageId
types.ImageMap: Declared relationship between original artifact, package and decoded image
types.Location: Resolved declared address plus original-file source fragments

groups.creator: Checked span constructors and source/load mapping methods
groups.states: Resolution is Resolved, Ambiguous or Unresolved; invalid arithmetic returns Err separately
groups.ui: Source ranges and unresolved/ambiguous address explanations
groups.prevents: Inventing a unique mapping or dropping fragmented provenance

types.PackageSpan: Logical package range qualified by ArtifactId
types.MappedSpan: Declared memory range qualified by ImageId
types.SourceMap: FWSC marker-removal mapping; one logical range can have several file fragments
types.FlashMap: Flash member location within its owning package
types.Resolution: Generic result with resolved value, all ambiguous candidates or an unresolved reason
types.LoadMap: Collection of declared regions; resolves the whole requested span

groups.creator: Exact-V15 reader and supplied format profile
groups.states: Identity, bounds and supported CRC checks; unsupported checks remain unresolved
groups.ui: Data view and package/application graph records
groups.prevents: Disassembling container bytes as if they were application bytes

types.PackageOffset: u64 coordinate after removing FWSC markers
types.FlashOffset: u64 coordinate within the flash member
types.SourceSpan: Original file offset and length retained as provenance
types.CrcCheck: Declared and computed checksum values; equality is a scoped check
types.PackageHeader: Parsed package header fields and checksum comparisons
types.PackageEntry: Typed directory entry, logical offsets, lengths and raw checksum result
types.Application: Checked application directory selection, identity and bounded previews
types.FirmwareView: Package, Entry(index) or Application projection into a graph record
types.FirmwareReport: Parsed package and optional application report with unresolved checks
types.MatchedV15: Runtime-only borrowed proof of exact source identity; not deserializable

groups.creator: Freshly checked V15 decoding
groups.states: Owns current verified image bytes and map; cannot be deserialized
groups.ui: Enables Disassemble only after source verification
groups.prevents: Using saved metadata to authorize a fresh tool read

types.DecodedImage: Runtime capability for the actual decoded bytes

groups.creator: Validated parser over captured vendor output and selected input bytes
groups.states: Instruction spans checked against input; destinations can be internal, external or unresolved
groups.ui: Code listing, control-flow graph and instruction inspector
groups.prevents: Presenting candidate static flow as observed execution

types.RunId: Nonzero disassembly identity within a case
types.Target: Direct declared address or unresolved destination text
types.Flow: Instruction transfer classification, separate from mnemonic text
types.Instruction: Address, image span, exact bytes, text and candidate transfer semantics
types.Gap: Selected bytes with no accepted decoded instruction
types.Coverage: Complete, Partial or Unavailable byte coverage
types.DisassemblyReport: Scope, map, exact input, wrapper hash, capture, accepted instructions, gaps and issues
types.Parsed: Private intermediate parser output; not a fresh source capability
types.BasicBlock: Conservative instruction interval with an explicit starting address
types.Destination: Internal block, external address, unresolved destination or return
types.EdgeKind: Typed jump, branch, call, return-site or unresolved control-flow relationship
types.FlowEdge: Candidate relationship with source block and destination state
types.ControlFlow: Basic blocks and candidate edges derived from one accepted report

groups.creator: Bounded pi32 adapter process wrapper
groups.states: Completed, Failed, Cancelled, TimedOut or OutputLimit; partial output stays diagnostic/limited
groups.ui: Tool prerequisites, outcome and full receipt
groups.prevents: Equating a successful process with complete analysis

types.ToolConfig: Selected distribution and installed disassembler executable
types.ToolOutcome: Terminal transport outcome independent of decode coverage
types.ToolCapture: Tool identity/version/flags, raw output, exit status, elapsed time and limitations
types.RunnerReport: Private helper response decoded before constructing the capture
types.OwnedDirectory: Private cleanup guard for this run's temporary directory

groups.creator: Installed isolated OMP bridge and strict protocol decoder
groups.states: Correlated ordered events and allowlisted operations; drafts remain provisional
groups.ui: Model catalogue, request receipt and inferred explanations
groups.prevents: Treating an unchecked model proposal as an executed probe

types.Catalogue: Installed SDK/CLI versions, configured default and available models
types.Proposal: Question, why, method, enables, unknowns, cited observations and requested scope
types.Analysis: Model explanation, significance, evidence citations and limitations
types.AiRun: Exact context snapshot, ordered events, checked proposal and published record references
types.Job: Runtime channel, cancellation and request identity; never reconstructed as a live job

groups.creator: Installed REA adapter and supported canonical entropy-bundle profile
groups.states: Complete canonical evidence or explicit incomplete/unsupported outcome
groups.ui: REA original-file evidence and retained ev_ identities
groups.prevents: Replacing REA provenance or interpreting entropy as proof of encryption

types.Request: Discovery, bounded original-file entropy request or supported bundle import
types.Receipt: Correlated adapter response retaining original canonical bundle
types.ReaRun: Receipt attached to one investigation record
types.Job: Runtime response channel and cancellation state

groups.creator: Pure checked controller and history audit
groups.states: Budget/scope/generation constraints apply to every transition
groups.ui: AI cycle controls and ordered execution history
groups.prevents: Out-of-scope probes, unlimited loops and stale publication

types.ProbeKey: Target, operation, offset, length and frozen profile identity for completed-request reuse
types.Scope: Allowed target identity, operation and bounded byte range
types.Mode: Running, Paused, Stopped, Completed or Failed
types.Phase: NeedModel, AwaitingModel, ReadyProbe, AwaitingProbe or Done
types.Controller: Sequential state, budget usage, request counts and status
types.Event: Cycle and question identity plus one typed execution detail
types.Detail: Started, pause/resume/stop, accepted/recorded probe, explanation and terminal accounting

groups.creator: Application runtime around the pure controller
groups.states: One current model/probe worker; generation changes invalidate stale results
groups.ui: Live AI cycle and evidence arriving behind a held reader
groups.prevents: Restoring executable workers from saved history

types.Target: Fresh V15 image capability or compiled synthetic teaching bytes
types.Settings: Human-selected question, model, budget, range and objective
types.Output: Private typed disassembly or synthetic-byte worker result
types.ProbeJob: Private worker ID, generation, cancellation flag and receiver
types.Engine: Runtime jobs, completed-probe cache, draft and checked controller

groups.creator: Append-only capture and deterministic offline replay
groups.states: Versioned event order, hash chain and validated resulting projection
groups.ui: Case history, checkpoints and analyst corrections
groups.prevents: Silently rewriting findings or pretending imported snapshots have full chronology

types.Document: Versioned baseline, provenance and ordered events
types.Event: Sequence number, previous commitment, typed payload and current commitment
types.Payload: Commit, JobStarted, JobEnded or Execution event
types.Change: Record/edge/receipt addition, note revision or objective steering
types.Role: Question, action, observation, explanation, hypothesis, open question or analyst decision classification
types.History: Validated document and reconstructed investigation projection

groups.creator: Deterministic projection from retained branch records
groups.states: Bounded records/text with explicit omitted IDs and excerpt markers
groups.ui: Branch memory / retained context in Harness Insight
groups.prevents: Depending on transient chat or hiding omitted evidence

types.BranchMemory: Selected branch, projected records/relationships and omissions
types.MemoryRecord: Retained role, rationale, plan, note, evidence/counter-evidence and original review target

groups.creator: Local file inspection
groups.states: Bounded source read with recorded metadata and optional fresh image
groups.ui: Open artifact and Verify source
groups.prevents: Confusing recorded identity with currently available source bytes

types.Inspection: Artifact metadata plus optional runtime DecodedImage

groups.creator: Explicit portable review selection
groups.states: Independent byte/text choices; original receipts require both
groups.ui: Export portable review
groups.prevents: Accidentally exporting full local receipts or treating a review export as a replay case

types.Options: Byte, analyst-text and original-receipt inclusion choices

groups.creator: Native event handlers and worker lifecycle
groups.states: Window state and deliberate file commands; unsaved changes checked before replacement
groups.ui: Menus, panels and shared selection
groups.prevents: Losing edits or publishing into a replacement case

types.FileCommand: Private requested file action pending prerequisite/unsaved checks
types.CodeJob: Private running disassembly identity, receiver and starting reading state
types.DivulgeApp: Native application state tying records, workers, graph and inspector together

groups.creator: Presentation controls over canonical record IDs
groups.states: Bounded layout and scope; positions/pins are presentation state
groups.ui: Graph cards, scopes and Navigate menu
groups.prevents: Changing evidence relationships by moving a node

types.Scope: Private All, Branch or Neighbors view
types.Navigation: Private named camera, selection, pin and movement actions
types.GraphView: ID-keyed positions, pins, scope anchor and camera bounds
types.GraphResponse: Selection or movement intent returned to the application

groups.creator: Terminal inspector widgets
groups.states: Record-local reading/editing state; findings remain canonical
groups.ui: Harness Insight
groups.prevents: Confusing a transient widget state with a saved observation

types.Inspector: Inspector selection, scalar interpretation and hypothesis form state

groups.creator: Borrowed projection of existing evidence
groups.states: Read-only references valid for the owner's lifetime
groups.ui: Data tables and byte views
groups.prevents: Copying a presentation projection into a second evidence store

types.ByteView: Borrowed bytes with source, length and decoding provenance

groups.creator: Native Code view controls
groups.states: Selected run/instruction, scope input and optional actions
groups.ui: Instruction listing and control flow
groups.prevents: Launching a tool merely by viewing saved instructions

types.CodeView: Code presentation, scope fields, conservative flow and camera

groups.creator: Model dialog and request controls
groups.states: Discovered catalogue and selected recorded/running request
groups.ui: OMP models and next step
groups.prevents: Changing the global OMP default or treating drafts as final

types.AiView: Model picker, request controls and retained receipts

groups.creator: AI cycle configuration and controls
groups.states: Start, pause, resume, stop and model-selection intent
groups.ui: AI cycle dialog and execution status strip
groups.prevents: Embedding unchecked execution inside widget rendering

types.EngineView: Question, scope, model and budget form

groups.creator: REA operation dialog
groups.states: Configured prerequisites, bounded input and retained run selection
groups.ui: REA original-file evidence
groups.prevents: Hiding adapter availability or incomplete output

types.ReaView: REA controls, job polling and receipt display

groups.creator: History and export dialogs
groups.states: Read-only checkpoints plus explicit append/review/export actions
groups.ui: Case history and review
groups.prevents: Editing past records through a replay preview

types.HistoryView: Checkpoint, review and portable-export form state

groups.creator: Bounded summary of the same source read used for artifact hashing
groups.states: At most 64 contiguous regions; exact counts, lengths and offsets; empty input has no rows
groups.ui: 3D matrix region/byte inspector
groups.prevents: Confusing a preview with a whole file or a byte distribution with recovered behavior

types.ByteWindow: One original-source span with 256 exact counts, entropy and a bounded preview
types.ByteMatrix: Whole input-span partition used only for statistical presentation

groups.creator: Native egui source-matrix controls
groups.states: Bounded camera, region and byte selection; no evidence or tool execution
groups.ui: 3D matrix projection, camera sliders and exact range inspector
groups.prevents: Turning camera motion or point selection into a new evidence claim

types.MatrixView: Presentation camera and selection over exact byte statistics
